startup.timing_note: Thresholds use integer DOS seconds and strict >; loading overlaps this progression. First stage forced immediately by subtracting21seconds.

player.character_outline_note: GX centers line thickness on nominal boundaries; three-pixel outline extends one pixel outward. Restores1px onaccept0x9146.

high_scores.record_format: NUL-terminated CP437 name (up to8chars), followed immediately by little-endian uint32 score; ten variable-length records

redefine.save_answer: Y activates custom controls and saves their bytes; N disables custom mappings, so keyboard ISR uses defaults (0xc758..0xc7cb).

save.state_scope: Start/current-level profile, words and cumulative score; no live actor positions, velocities, collected book state or RNG stored.

text_encoding: Strings decoded CP437; bytes field preserves BIOS glyph indices (important for UK pound-sign row).
